58009290.title: #01 Classic Wash
58009290.description:
Hand washing of the bodywork with pH-neutral foam, with a focus on paintwork safety. 
 After the foam is applied, the wheel arches are cleaned, the vehicle is rinsed, dried with microfiber towels, and the tires are treated with tire dressing for a deep black finish.

58009452.title: #02 Two-Phase Wash
58009452.description:
Two-phase hand wash with active foam, thorough body cleaning, and tire treatment. 
 Ideal for vehicles with a higher level of dirt contamination.

58009540.title: #03 Three-Phase Washing
58009540.description:
Premium three-stage hand wash with detailed wheel cleaning and nano wax application. 
 This service combines double foam application, manual body washing, and final paintwork treatment for a flawless appearance.

58009762.title: #04 Detailing Wash
58009762.description: Comprehensive detailing wash with professional interior and exterior care, focused on every detail. The result is a refreshed, spotless vehicle with a premium finish and a showroom-like appearance.

58009942.title: #05 Interior Deep Cleaning + Standard Wash
58009942.description: Includes everything from the standard wash plus a complete deep interior cleaning with seat removal for maximum cleanliness and attention to detail.

58009984.title: #18 Engine Bay Cleaning
58009984.description: Professional cleaning and treatment of the engine bay with maximum care for electronic components.

58010022.title: #07 One-Step Paint Correction
58010022.description: Paint correction designed to restore paint depth and gloss while removing minor scratches and oxidation.

58010077.title: #08 Two-Step Paint Correction
58010077.description: Comprehensive paint correction for deep restoration of the paintwork and a mirror-like shine.

58010123.title: #09 Three-Step Paint Correction (Premium Correction)
58010123.description: The highest level of paint restoration. Three-step correction removes deeper scratches and gives the bodywork a flawless mirror finish.

58010450.title: #10 Full Paint Correction & Ceramic Protection
58010450.description: Premium treatment for complete paint restoration and protection. The combination of three-step polishing and ceramic coating application delivers exceptional gloss and long-lasting protection.
